semanticModels.name: rail_station_entries
semanticModels.description: 'L' turnstile entries, one row per station per service day.

measures.name: rail_entries
measures.label: Rail entries
measures.description: Turnstile entries at 'L' stations. Transfers between lines inside the paid area are not counted.

measures.name: rail_service_days
measures.label: Rail service days
measures.description: Distinct service days with reported entries.

measures.name: rail_stations_reporting
measures.label: Stations reporting
measures.description: Distinct stations with a reported count (a zero counts as reported).

semanticModels.name: bus_route_rides
semanticModels.description: Bus boardings, one row per route per service day.

measures.name: bus_boardings
measures.label: Bus boardings
measures.description: Boardings on CTA buses. A trip with a bus-to-bus transfer counts once per bus.

dimensions.name: sector
dimensions.label: Sector
dimensions.description: Approximate sector from the bearing to State & Madison; Loop inside the elevated Loop.

dimensions.name: is_transfer_station
dimensions.label: Transfer station
dimensions.description: Served by more than one line.

dimensions.name: route_type
dimensions.label: Route type
dimensions.description: Express (X routes), Shuttle (1000-series rail-replacement buses) or Local.

semanticModels.name: service_days
semanticModels.description: Calendar days with the CTA day type (holidays run a Sunday schedule).

dimensions.name: day_type
dimensions.label: Day type
dimensions.description: Weekday, Saturday, or Sunday/Holiday, as the CTA scheduled the day.

dimensions.name: is_holiday
dimensions.label: Holiday
dimensions.description: A Monday-Saturday the CTA ran a Sunday schedule.

semanticModels.name: rail_line_entries
semanticModels.description: 'L' entries by line, one row per station per line per service day.

measures.name: line_entries_allocated
measures.label: Line entries (allocated)
measures.description: Station entries split evenly across the lines that run there all day (no share for the Purple Line Express south of Howard). Sums to the system total.

measures.name: line_station_entries
measures.label: Entries at line stations
measures.description: Full entries at every station the line serves; transfer stations count for each line. Never sum across lines.

metrics.name: rail_entries
metrics.label: Rail entries
metrics.description: Turnstile entries at 'L' stations. Transfers between lines inside the paid area are not counted.

metrics.name: rail_service_days
metrics.label: Rail service days
metrics.description: Distinct service days with reported station entries.

metrics.name: rail_stations_reporting
metrics.label: Stations reporting
metrics.description: Distinct stations with a reported count (zero counts as reported).

metrics.name: rail_avg_daily_entries
metrics.label: Avg daily rail entries
metrics.description: Rail entries per service day for the group.

metrics.name: rail_avg_weekday_entries
metrics.label: Avg weekday rail entries
metrics.description: Rail entries per weekday (CTA weekday schedule; holidays excluded).

metrics.name: rail_avg_saturday_entries
metrics.label: Avg Saturday rail entries
metrics.description: Rail entries per Saturday.

metrics.name: rail_avg_sunday_entries
metrics.label: Avg Sunday/holiday rail entries
metrics.description: Rail entries per Sunday or holiday.

metrics.name: rail_entries_ly
metrics.label: Rail entries, 52 weeks earlier
metrics.description: Rail entries for the same period 52 weeks earlier. Compared with 364 days earlier, so weekdays line up (Monday vs Monday).

metrics.name: rail_entries_yoy
metrics.label: Rail entries vs 52 weeks earlier
metrics.description: Change in rail entries vs the same period 52 weeks earlier. Compared with 364 days earlier, so weekdays line up (Monday vs Monday).

metrics.name: rail_avg_weekday_entries_ly
metrics.label: Avg weekday rail entries, 52 weeks earlier
metrics.description: Average weekday rail entries for the same period 52 weeks earlier. Compared with 364 days earlier, so weekdays line up (Monday vs Monday).

metrics.name: rail_avg_weekday_yoy
metrics.label: Avg weekday rail entries vs 52 weeks earlier
metrics.description: Change in average weekday rail entries vs 52 weeks earlier. Compared with 364 days earlier, so weekdays line up (Monday vs Monday).

metrics.name: bus_boardings
metrics.label: Bus boardings
metrics.description: Boardings on CTA buses. A trip with a bus-to-bus transfer counts once per bus.

metrics.name: bus_service_days
metrics.label: Bus service days
metrics.description: Distinct service days with reported boardings.

metrics.name: bus_routes_reporting
metrics.label: Routes reporting
metrics.description: Distinct routes with a reported count.

metrics.name: bus_avg_daily_boardings
metrics.label: Avg daily bus boardings
metrics.description: Bus boardings per service day for the group.

metrics.name: bus_avg_weekday_boardings
metrics.label: Avg weekday bus boardings
metrics.description: Bus boardings per weekday (holidays excluded).

metrics.name: bus_avg_saturday_boardings
metrics.label: Avg Saturday bus boardings
metrics.description: Bus boardings per Saturday.

metrics.name: bus_avg_sunday_boardings
metrics.label: Avg Sunday/holiday bus boardings
metrics.description: Bus boardings per Sunday or holiday.

metrics.name: bus_boardings_ly
metrics.label: Bus boardings, 52 weeks earlier
metrics.description: Bus boardings for the same period 52 weeks earlier. Compared with 364 days earlier, so weekdays line up (Monday vs Monday).

metrics.name: bus_boardings_yoy
metrics.label: Bus boardings vs 52 weeks earlier
metrics.description: Change in bus boardings vs the same period 52 weeks earlier. Compared with 364 days earlier, so weekdays line up (Monday vs Monday).

metrics.name: bus_avg_weekday_boardings_ly
metrics.label: Avg weekday bus boardings, 52 weeks earlier
metrics.description: Average weekday bus boardings 52 weeks earlier. Compared with 364 days earlier, so weekdays line up (Monday vs Monday).

metrics.name: bus_avg_weekday_yoy
metrics.label: Avg weekday bus boardings vs 52 weeks earlier
metrics.description: Change in average weekday bus boardings vs 52 weeks earlier. Compared with 364 days earlier, so weekdays line up (Monday vs Monday).

metrics.name: total_rides
metrics.label: Total rides (rail + bus)
metrics.description: Rail entries plus bus boardings. Mixes two counting methods (entries vs boardings), as the CTA does in its own totals.

metrics.name: total_rides_ly
metrics.label: Total rides, 52 weeks earlier
metrics.description: Rail entries plus bus boardings 52 weeks earlier. Compared with 364 days earlier, so weekdays line up (Monday vs Monday).

metrics.name: total_rides_yoy
metrics.label: Total rides vs 52 weeks earlier
metrics.description: Change in total rides vs 52 weeks earlier. Compared with 364 days earlier, so weekdays line up (Monday vs Monday).

metrics.name: rail_share
metrics.label: Rail share of rides
metrics.description: Rail entries as a share of rail entries plus bus boardings.

metrics.name: total_avg_weekday_rides
metrics.label: Avg weekday rides (rail + bus)
metrics.description: Average weekday rail entries plus average weekday bus boardings.

metrics.name: line_avg_daily_allocated
metrics.label: Avg daily line entries (allocated)
metrics.description: Allocated line entries per service day.

metrics.name: line_avg_weekday_yoy
metrics.label: Avg weekday line entries vs 52 weeks earlier
metrics.description: Change in allocated line entries per weekday vs 52 weeks earlier. Compared with 364 days earlier, so weekdays line up (Monday vs Monday).

metrics.name: line_avg_weekday_allocated
metrics.label: Avg weekday line entries (allocated)
metrics.description: Allocated line entries per weekday.

metrics.name: line_avg_weekday_allocated_ly
metrics.label: Avg weekday line entries, 52 weeks earlier
metrics.description: Allocated line entries per weekday, 52 weeks earlier. Compared with 364 days earlier, so weekdays line up (Monday vs Monday).

metrics.name: line_service_days
metrics.label: Line service days
metrics.description: Distinct service days with entries on the line.

metrics.name: line_station_entries
metrics.label: Entries at line stations
metrics.description: Full entries at every station on the line; a transfer station counts toward each of its lines. Shows a line's reach. Never sum across lines.

metrics.name: line_entries_allocated
metrics.label: Line entries (allocated)
metrics.description: Station entries split evenly across the lines that run there all day (the Purple Line Express gets no share at its rush-only stops south of Howard). Lines sum to the system total.

savedQueries.name: accessible_station_weekday
